sourceTool: built-in image_gen plus deterministic Node packaging converter

inspection.result: Raw built-in masters and Node-derived package sizes were inspected visually at master scale, 16 pixel scale, and social-preview scale. The canonical mark is text-free, genuinely transparent, simple, violet and teal, with no cursor or grid detail. The wide composition uses the same visual identity, generous margins, and abstract workspace panels without text, device framing, or third-party marks. No Python image manipulation or normalization was used. The raw built-in output retains visible tonal variation, so the no-gradient requirement remains an explicit limitation of the built-in route rather than a falsely claimed property.

logoMaster.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final spot-color vector icon
Primary request: Design an original minimal icon made from exactly two flat spot-color shapes. The outer shape is a simple interlocking C and D silhouette in one constant purple ink. The inner shape is one small teal triangular inset. Use exactly two opaque inks, deep purple and teal, with uniform color inside each shape. Think of a two-color screen-print stencil or a flat SVG icon, not a rendered illustration.
Scene/backdrop: transparent
Subject: one centered abstract emblem
Style/medium: pure flat vector icon, spot colors, hard clean edges
Composition/framing: 1:1 square, centered, generous clear margin, legible at 16 pixels
Color palette: purple #6D28D9 and teal #14B8A6, exactly
Materials/textures: none
Text (verbatim): none
Constraints: transparent background; exactly two opaque spot colors; constant color within each shape; no gradient; no shading; no lighting; no vignette; no glow; no shadow; no texture; no bevel; no 3D; no anti-aliased color fringes; no cursor; no grid; no text; no watermark; no extra colors; original symbol; no resemblance to existing logos
Avoid: illustration, rendering, dimensionality, soft edges, bevels, gloss, color transitions, noise, checkerboard pixels
